rows.en:
"Ugh!"
Right then, something I couldn't make out hit me square in the face.{p}
So what do you think we did?
You ran for your lives
You examined the thing
I got scared and raced Iwayama for the exit, each of us trying to get there first.{p}

We ran through the darkness.
Banging into things all over the place.{p}

I was dying to know what that thing was.
I said to Iwayama,
"I'm gonna try touching it."
Iwayama said to me,
"Is that safe? Be careful."
Touching something in the dark isn't exactly a pleasant feeling.
Even less so when it's something you can't identify.
But then again, touching some unknown thing in the dark also stirs up your curiosity.
And it seems that side of me was stronger.
It might have been dangerous, but I was itching to touch it.
So I slowly reached out toward the spot where the thing ought to be.{p}

"...!"
I almost cried out.{p}

The thing was there, all right.
It was warm.
The warmth of human skin.
I called over to him.
"Iwayama, you touch it too.
We came all this way.
You should get a taste of it yourself.
Coming here just to throw up is pathetic."
"Fine... Shut up already."{p}

Iwayama groped around, trying to touch the thing too.
"Wow, this feels kind of nice..."
Looked like Iwayama had finally touched it.
That's right, the thing felt really good to the touch.
Touching it, you didn't feel scared so much as safe, or calm, or something...
It was soft, like it was filled with warm liquid, but the surface was firm and taut.
Iwayama said,
"Hino, this feels amazing.
I wouldn't mind staying here forever."
Iwayama suddenly started talking nonsense.
I got nervous and said,
"Don't say weird stuff.
Hey, why don't we call it a day and head home?"
"I just want to stay like this, held by this lump.
I don't care what happens to me."
Something was definitely off about him.
I told Iwayama firmly,
"Hey, get a grip☆
What kind of half-asleep crap are you talking!"
Right then, the thing started to glow, like a firefly.{p}

At first it glowed slowly, just the faintest light.
Little by little, the light grew stronger.
I could see now that it was a transparent, pale pink lump.
And at the same moment, I was left speechless.{p}

Of all things, Iwayama had shoved his whole face into that transparent lump.
He looked like a piece of fruit sealed inside a jelly sweet.
Even inside that translucent lump, Iwayama's eyes were wide open.
Wasn't he suffocating?
And he was looking at me, with a huge grin all over his face.{p}
The look on his face right then was seriously creepy.{p}So what do you think I did next?
You left Iwayama behind and ran
You saved Iwayama

I ran.
I abandoned Iwayama, pathetic as that is...
I ran at full speed.
Slamming into everything around me.
There was nothing I could do, and the next day came.{p}

...Iwayama didn't come to school.
Not the next day, or the day after that...
I was tormented by guilt.
I kept thinking I should have saved Iwayama back then...{p}

Every night after that, I had dreams.
Even in my dreams, that face of his would show up and smile at me.{p}

Then a week later, wouldn't you know it, Iwayama showed up at school, alive and well.
I felt like I was dreaming.
I staggered over to him.
"Thank God, Iwayama☆ You're okay☆"
With that, I threw my arms around him as hard as I could.
"Ew, gross, don't hug me.
I'm totally fine."
Iwayama flashed a V sign and grinned.
Then after school that day, Iwayama and I stayed behind in the classroom and talked about what had happened that night.
First, I apologized for abandoning him and running away.
He laughed and forgave me without a second thought, saying he'd made it out fine, after all.
Then he told me how he'd escaped from that storeroom.
"Well, after that I suddenly came to my senses.
I pulled my head out of that weird lump as fast as I could.
That jelly stuff had gotten into my windpipe, and it was awful.
I was coughing like crazy.
I couldn't breathe.
But somehow I got away.
And that's how I made it out.
I did run a bit of a fever, so I ended up missing school for a week after that, though."
Anyway, I was just glad he'd made it.
And we chatted away about this and that for a while.
You see, I'd been worried sick about Iwayama, right?{p}

So knowing he was alive, I guess all the exhaustion hit me at once, and my vision started to blur.
Iwayama's face kept going fuzzy.{p}

Iwayama peered at me, looking worried.
"What's wrong?"
Iwayama put both hands on my shoulders.
"I'm just kind of tired..."
Then I looked at Iwayama's face.
I couldn't believe my eyes.{p}

Half of his face was see-through.
The background behind him was showing through, half-transparent.
"Iwayama, what the hell are you★"
I tried to get away from Iwayama, but he had my shoulders gripped tight, so I couldn't move.{p}Now, what would you do?
I'd have no choice but to fight
I'd have no choice but to run

I realized right away that Iwayama wasn't normal.
That he'd gone wrong back then because of that unidentifiable thing.
I figured I had no choice but to fight.
I did feel guilty for leaving him behind, but I couldn't let him get me here.{p}

I gripped Iwayama's shoulders right back.
Neither of us would give an inch.
Iwayama brought his mouth close to my face and said,
"After that, Shirai saved me.
Heh, don't be stupid.
You think that guy would save me for nothing?
It was a trade.
In exchange, I had to let him tinker with my body.
So for a week after that, Shirai tinkered with this body however he pleased.
I hated you for it. If you hadn't abandoned me back then, I'd never have ended up like this.
But right now I feel fantastic.
I'm grateful to you.
So to thank you, I'm gonna give you the same treatment I got."
Iwayama licked my face!{p}

Since then, there's been no word of Iwayama.
So, yeah, that's the kind of story it is.
...It bothered me, so {f:I|I} asked Hino about it.
"Um... Did you tell the police about Iwayama?"
"...No, I didn't.
I don't even want to remember it.
I tried to wipe that storeroom from my memory as best I could.
No, I'm still trying, even now...
But I can't forget it.
Of course I can't. There's no way I could ever forget it."{p}

For an instant, Hino looked blurry.
His face seemed to waver, like ripples on water.
Hino had a nasty grin on his face.
{f:I|I} knew by instinct that he was about to do something to us.
If we just sat still like this, there was no telling what he'd do to us.
...And yet.
Right now I was in the grip of a feeling that I didn't want to think about anything, didn't want to do anything at all.
"Looks like the drug is working nicely on you all.
Heh heh heh, I put a drug in those drinks.
You're all going to merge with us.
Once you join us, each of you will be able to bring out your own talents to the fullest.
As we merge with more and more people, in the end we'll become a single life-form inferior to no one.
Amazing, isn't it?
You should be rejoicing.
And you should be grateful to Mr. Shirai, too, for making this research a success."
Then the dimly wavering Hino held his palm out toward {f:us|us}.{p}

There was a face on his palm.
The face mumbled, its mouth working.
"Nice to meet you, I'm Iwayama.
From now on, we're all going to be one, body and soul.
Let's get along. Pleased to meet you."
{f:I|I} could only stare at it, speechless.{p}

Then Hino's skin gradually turned a translucent pale pink.
Swaying softly from side to side.{p}

Just then, it was as if a pale pink curtain had dropped over my eyes.
What do I do★{p}Am I just going to meet my end like this, with no will left{f:|}★
Accept it
Make one last attempt to resist

So is this it? Are {f:we|we} going to be absorbed like this and meet our end{f:|}?
Hino was putting out pale pink tentacles from all over his body, trying to absorb the six of {f:us|us}.
Maybe it really would be better to merge with everyone.
If I was just going to spend my days at this school as an ordinary nobody, then surely this would be better...{p}

So is this it? Are {f:we|we} going to be absorbed like this and meet our end{f:|}?
Hino was putting out pale pink tentacles from all over his body, trying to absorb the six of {f:us|us}.
{f:We|We} were already covered by a thin membrane.
Suddenly, {f:I|I} felt myself resisting the idea of being merged into this monster.
Even in my listless state, I {f:felt|felt} something.
And I decided to make one last attempt to resist.{p}

{f:I|I} shut my eyes and poured all my strength and will into it.
But despite what {f:I|I} felt, the merging with everyone seemed to be going ahead.{p}

Then, as if nothing had happened, {f:I|I} was standing in the same place as before.
Hadn't {f:I|I} merged with everyone{f:|}?
Shouldn't I have become something inhuman, with the faces of all the merged people stuck all over my body{f:|}?
"...Splendid."
{f:I|I} turned toward the voice.{p}

There stood the White-Haired Demon... Mr. Shirai.
"Those who are absorbed and merged all lose their form.
Only the one with the strongest willpower among them can keep the form they had in life.
Hino's willpower was strong too, but not strong enough to hold down the others like this.
Keep working at it.
Do that, and you'll be able to draw out only the best parts of everyone you've absorbed so far, and everyone you'll absorb from now on, and use them however you please.
And of course, you can still go on existing as yourself.
Truly wonderful.
My masterpiece.
I'll come back to check on you."{p}
"Help me.{p}

I want to get out of here.
Why am I in a place like this..."
It was the murmuring of those who had been merged{f:|}...
And at the same time, {f:I|I} noticed a single desire rearing its head inside me.
That's {f:right|right}. From now on I'll merge with more and more of them and become the ultimate life-form...
No matter what.
Laughter welled up from the pit of my stomach.
Picturing myself as the most beautiful, the strongest, the wisest of all living things in this world, {f:I|I} felt almost drunk with it.{p}

I couldn't just abandon Iwayama and run.
I yanked him out of that jelly lump with all my strength.
With a wet shlup, shlup, Iwayama popped free of the lump.
I went tumbling head over heels.
That pale pink jelly lump was giving off a faint glow, lighting up the area with an eerie light.
But we had bigger things to worry about.
I hauled Iwayama on my shoulder, bumping into things all the way, and finally got outside.
Then I pounded the stuff out of his mouth and throat.
And coughing and hacking, he came back to his senses.
Even we were pretty fed up after that, so we headed straight home that day.{p}

What was that weird jelly lump?
No, that was just one step in the research.
There's got to be something hidden in there that's way more incredible than that thing.
I couldn't shake the feeling that Shirai was raising something in there.
That's what I went through, just about a week ago.{p}

I ran away again.
Just like that other time...
I spat in Iwayama's face, and when he flinched, I slipped out of his grip.
I ran.
I was scared that if I stopped running, Iwayama would catch up with me.
I barely made it out alive.
...Iwayama's been missing ever since.
I've made a point of staying away from that storeroom.{p}

...Hold on.
Shh!
Don't you hear something?
...That's got to be... got to be Iwayama!
I can tell.
Iwayama's come looking for me.
If he finds out I'm here, I'm in trouble.{p}{a}, turn off the light!
Turn off the light
Don't turn off the light

Footsteps came closer and closer.
Then the footsteps were as close as they could get.
{f:We|We} caught our breath.
When the footsteps reached the front of the club room, they stopped dead.
Whoever the footsteps belonged to seemed to be just standing there{f:|}.
My eyes {f:were|were} slowly getting used to the dark, but I couldn't see clearly{f:|}.{p}
Then, all of a sudden, the door was flung open.{p}

{f:We|We} were too terrified to speak.
The thing began to pad around {f:us|us} as we sat around the table.
Pad, pad... pad, pad, walking along as if checking each of us one by one.
Every time {f:I|I} heard the footsteps behind me, I squeezed my eyes shut.
And after circling {f:us|us} about five times, {f:it|it} suddenly stopped walking.{p}

"Eek!"
I heard a short scream.{p}

And in that instant, there was a sound like water running down a drain.
For a while, {f:we|we} couldn't move or speak.{p}

Just then came a thundering noise, like a beast running, and a tremendous blast of air rushed right past {f:me|me}.
Then came the sound of the door slamming shut.
{f:I|I} couldn't move, frozen in a half-crouch.{p}
"Click."{p}

Kazama spoke.
"H-Hino's gone..."{p}

"Hmph, I suppose that Iwayama person took him away, didn't he?
He had it coming, don't you think?"
Iwashita said languidly.
...It was true, Hino might have been taken away.
I shouldn't have turned off the light back then...
Iwashita went on.
"Well, now Hino has told us the seventh story himself, in the flesh.
{a}{f:|}, you're lucky to have a club president who cares so much about his juniors.
You'll be able to make an interesting newspaper. Heh heh heh."
A cold laugh.
After what had just happened right in front of us, what was she {f:saying|saying}?{p}

...But {f:I|I} knew.
That I was surely going to write up what had just happened as an article.
A corner of my mind felt strangely clear and refreshed.
This is going to make a great article{f:|}.
Is this what they call a reporter's spirit, I {f:wonder|wonder}?
Thinking such things, {f:I|I} slowly nodded.{p}

It was still safer to see things clearly than to have something happen in total darkness{f:|}.
{f:I|I} said to Hino,
"Maybe it's better not to make it dark right now."
Even so, Hino still {f:looked|looked} uneasy.{p}

Footsteps came closer and closer.
Then the footsteps were as close as they could get.
{f:We|We} caught our breath.
When the footsteps reached the front of the club room, they stopped dead.
Whoever the footsteps belonged to {f:seemed|seemed} to be just standing there.
I could definitely sense someone there.
For some reason, Hino suddenly walked over to the door.{p}
And he flung the door wide open.{p}

...There was a man there whose face and body looked half-melted.
He was down on all fours, looking up at Hino from below.
Not only {f:we|we}, but Hino too was unable to move from the spot.
"...Iwayama."
Hino murmured.
...So this was Iwayama{f:|}.
His face was melting, so I couldn't make it out clearly.
The man called Iwayama let the translucent, jelly-like fluid dripping from his body drip onto Hino, as if to wrap him up in it.
And by the time his fluid had covered Hino's whole body...
Hino, who had been standing frozen until then, spun around to face us.{p}

Standing there was a man I'd never seen before.
The man said,
"I'm sure you've all figured it out by now.
I'm Iwayama.
From now on, Hino and I are one.
Body and soul together.
But I've got the upper hand over Hino, by a long shot.
Long story short, I've sealed Hino up inside me. Heh heh heh."
With that, Iwayama tore his own face apart down the middle to show us.
Inside was Hino's face, on the verge of tears.
"Get me out of here☆"
Before Hino could even finish saying it, Iwayama stuck his face back together the way it was.
"So, you guys don't need to worry."
With that, Iwayama left the club room.{p}

But Hino wasn't dead{f:|}.
He'd only lost his freedom{f:|}...
Still, a life where you're never free might really be so painful that you'd be better off dead{f:|}.
And... Iwayama {f:had said|had said} we didn't need to worry, hadn't he?
But to be seen by {f:us|us} and then just leave like that...
Even though {f:we|we} might talk if anyone asked where Hino had gone.
Was he lying in wait outside the club room{f:|}?
Waiting for {f:us|us} to come strolling out, relieved?
I felt the air stir, sending a chill over my skin.
Unable to move, {f:we|we} just stared at each other...{p}

All right.
Then how about this one?{p}
